scenario_text: A localized wave packet is prepared in free space with an initial spatial spread and momentum uncertainty. As it propagates without any potential, its spatial width grows over time. The experiment follows the broadening of the packet width and its momentum spread. This probes dispersive spreading arising from the range of constituent wavelengths.
